title: Verify: listExecutions unit tests with mocked fetch
summary: Unit tests for listExecutions request and error behavior
description: Add game/frontend/tests/executions.test.ts testing listExecutions with a stubbed global fetch.
acceptance_criteria: Test asserts URL, Bearer header and parsed array
Test asserts ApiError status 401 on a 401 response
technical_constraints: Fixture executionFixture in game/frontend/tests/fixtures/api.ts mirrors execution.Execution JSON and the List handler in backend/internal/execution/handler.go; do not inline the payload

steps.action: Create the test file importing listExecutions, ApiError from ../src/api/client and executionFixture from ./fixtures/api. Add test 'sends GET with Bearer token and returns the array': vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(new Response(JSON.stringify([executionFixture]), {status:200}))), call listExecutions('tok'), assert result equals [executionFixture], URL is '/api/v1/admin/executions', and new Headers(init.headers).get('Authorization') is 'Bearer tok'. Add test 'rejects with ApiError 401': fetch returns status 401, assert rejects with ApiError and status 401. Unstub globals in afterEach.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executions.test.ts -t listExecutions
